Impact des failles PHP2Shell et interven: Impact of PHP2Shell vulnerabilities and emergency interventions
Des brèches critiques, présentes depuis: Critical breaches, present for over twenty years in the PHP language which powers approximately seventy percent of websites, have been uncovered by researchers using artificial intelligence tools. Spotted by the team at Wiz, a Google subsidiary, with the help of Gemini and GPT-5.6 Sol models, these vulnerabilities required urgent patches. This rapid compliance update resulted in the temporary downtime of numerous portals, notably affecting tax websites in France, platforms of several prefectures, as well as the Orange and Météo France portals. According to Palo Alto Networks, nearly twenty-two million platforms worldwide are exposed, and attacks have already been observed across the global network.
L'exploitation de l'intelligence artific: The exploitation of artificial intelligence is fundamentally changing the game in cybersecurity. According to Samuel Hassine, CEO and co-founder of Filigran, the speed benefits both sides, as the acceleration of vulnerability discovery goes hand in hand with the accelerated development of exploitation tactics by hackers. Romain Meunier, Solutions Architect at Integrity360, points out that this technology makes it possible to reveal anomalies that remained undetected for several decades. This phenomenon is part of a trend observed in recent months, during which Anthropic's Claude Mythos AI also highlighted long-standing vulnerabilities, such as "Squidbleed" in Squid, as well as 27-year-old flaws in OpenBSD and 16-year-old flaws in FFmpeg. For Guillaume Vassault-Houliere, CEO of YesWeHack, this type of crisis is bound to repeat itself under the effect of these new methods.
